# Design

## Goal

Define the behavior and technical responsibilities of the requested slice.

## Procedure

1. Read [Project.md](../../Project.md), the relevant requirements, authorization model, and actual source if present.
2. State the problem, users, triggers, expected outcome, and exclusions.
3. Specify normal and failure flows, inputs/outputs, affected data, access scope, and acceptance IDs.
4. Compare only materially different alternatives. Label selected proposals and unresolved decisions.
5. Record the design in [Copilot_Task.md](../TaskLogs/Copilot_Task.md), using its marker headings. Link durable decisions from the knowledge base when appropriate.

## Output

A concrete design that can be planned and tested. A design-only request stops at documentation; it does not start scaffolding, deployment, or provider setup.
